title: Tour diagram highlight
lead: Start guided. Each chapter opens a diagram and highlights one table, row, connection or step, with the rest of the drawing dimmed.
changes: Start guided, then step with Next or the arrow keys.
Check that the reader pans and zooms to each highlighted part.
Exit the tour and confirm the diagram is no longer dimmed.

chapters.title: The flag table
chapters.body: Each flag is one row in this table. The rest of the map stays visible but quieter.

chapters.title: Delivery hours
chapters.body: This row holds the delivery window. The tour points at the row itself, not at a row number.

chapters.title: Tenant key
chapters.body: Every flag belongs to one tenant, through this key.

chapters.title: The gate check
chapters.body: Settings flow from the read step into the gate on every new task.

chapters.title: The fallback
chapters.body: When the gate says no, the task keeps the existing behaviour.
